name: 学びの達成バッジの横並び
prompt:
Edit Reference 1 to match Reference 2, the authoritative 390×260 native preview. References 3–5 are the exact original badge artwork and define the medal shapes, blue progress arc, neutral line art and labels. Preserve the component structure and visible horizontal crop.

The user dislikes tint colors. Make the whole component canvas, all exposed matte around each medal, and the flat field inside every circular medal pure white #FFFFFF. The first pass removed the cream square matte but left pale gray disks inside the medals; remove those pale background fills too. Preserve the existing thin neutral-gray medal rings, gray cloud/ribbon/question-mark drawings, and original blue progress arc exactly in appearance. Keep blue only as the progress arc. Do not add any other colored or tinted surface, gray circle fill, cream, mint, blush, gradient, shadow, glow or texture.

Exact native layout on 390×260: heading x=16/y=8, 358×28, Meiryo Bold 20/28, #1D1D1D, “これまでの達成”. Three horizontally clipped badge images, each 168×168 at y=58: first x=-88, second x=96, third x=280. Retain the same left and right clipping as Reference 2. Replace only each matte and inner disk background with white; do not move or redraw the circle outlines or badge motifs. Labels at y=234 in Meiryo Regular 12/16, #1D1D1D: x=0/168 width “一週間の学び”; x=96/168 width “二週間の学び”; x=280/94 width “説明する力”.

Keep the blank canvas white with no cards, tinted tiles, buttons or extra content. Do not alter Japanese copy or the progress arc. Return only the component.
reviewNotes: Cream matte and pale-gray medal fields removed; fine pixel identity of rendered badge art remains unverified after one correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
